import numpy as np 
import torch
from rastermap import Rastermap
from tqdm import trange 
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, "../")
from powerlaw import fit_powerlaw_exp, zscore_and_compute_evals
import simulations

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

print("simulating symmetric random connectivity dynamics")
simulations.set_seed(0, device)
# run w/ more timepoints per sim for continuous rastermap segment
Asym_ex, Xsym_ex, esym_ex = simulations.simulate_random(nn=10000, nonsym=0, nd=40, T=100000)
Xt = Xsym_ex[:, :1000].cpu().numpy()
# compute eigenvalues of covariance
evals_sym, evecs = zscore_and_compute_evals(Xsym_ex)
alpha, yp = fit_powerlaw_exp(evals_sym, np.arange(10, 500))
print(fr"symmetric; alpha = {alpha:.3f}")
model = Rastermap(n_clusters=100, n_PCs=128, mean_time=False,
                            normalize=False, bin_size=20, time_bin=7).fit(Xsym_ex.cpu().numpy())
Xemb_sym = model.X_embedding.copy()

print("simulating nonsymmetric random connectivity dynamics")
simulations.set_seed(4, device)
Anonsym_ex, Xnonsym_ex, enonsym_ex = simulations.simulate_random(nn=10000, nonsym=1, nd=40, T=100000)
evals_nonsym, evecs = zscore_and_compute_evals(Xnonsym_ex)
alpha, yp = fit_powerlaw_exp(evals_nonsym, np.arange(10, 200))
print(fr"nonsymmetric; alpha = {alpha:.3f}")

model = Rastermap(n_clusters=100, n_PCs=128, mean_time=False,
                            normalize=False, bin_size=20, time_bin=7).fit(Xnonsym_ex.cpu().numpy())
Xemb_nonsym = model.X_embedding.copy()


os.makedirs("../results", exist_ok=True)
np.save("../results/ex_fig1.npy", {"esym_ex": esym_ex.cpu().numpy(), "enonsym_ex": enonsym_ex.cpu().numpy(),
                                   "evals_sym": evals_sym, "evals_nonsym": evals_nonsym,
                                   "Asym_ex": Asym_ex.cpu().numpy(), "Xt": Xt,
                                   "Anonsym_ex": Anonsym_ex.cpu().numpy(),
                                   "Xemb_sym": Xemb_sym, "Xemb_nonsym": Xemb_nonsym,})

import fig1
dat = np.load("../results/ex_fig1.npy", allow_pickle=True).item()
fig = fig1.fig1(dat)
os.makedirs("../figures", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("../figures/fig1.pdf")

out = simulations.random_probs_sim(n_sim=10, nn=10000, device=device)
evals_all, Aexs, distributions = out
np.save("../results/evals_probs.npy", {"evals_all": evals_all, "Aexs": Aexs, 
                                "distributions": distributions})

out = simulations.random_uniform_sim_sizes(n_sim=10, nonsyms=[0, 1./3, 2./3, 1])
alphas, evals_gt_all, evals_all, evals_svca_all, evals_svca2_all, nonsyms, nneurons, ntimes, noise_levels = out

np.save("../results/evals_sizes_shot_noise.npy", {"alphas": alphas, "evals_gt_all": evals_gt_all, "evals_all": evals_all, 
                                       "evals_svca_all": evals_svca_all, "evals_svca2_all": evals_svca2_all,
                                         "nonsyms": nonsyms, "nneurons": nneurons, "ntimes": ntimes, 
                                         "noise_levels": noise_levels})

dat = np.load("../results/evals_probs.npy", allow_pickle=True).item()
fig = fig1.suppfig_probs(dat)
fig.savefig("../figures/suppfig_probs.pdf")

dat = np.load("../results/ex_fig1.npy", allow_pickle=True).item()
dat2 = np.load("../results/evals_sizes_shot_noise.npy", allow_pickle=True).item()
fig = fig1.suppfig_sim(dat, dat2)
fig.savefig("../figures/suppfig_sim.pdf")

dat = np.load("../results/evals_tbins.npy", allow_pickle=True).item()
fig = fig1.suppfig_tbin(dat)
fig.savefig("../figures/suppfig_tbin.pdf")

fig = fig1.suppfig_poisson(dat2)
fig.savefig("../figures/suppfig_poisson.pdf")
